When the tokenizer returns null for a slot, fall back to the default path byte_5EA438.

Else if a4 == 6 and the entry equals aOther ("other"), rewrite 0x01 bytes in the token to backslashes and run AudioMixerPollingUpdateLoop(v6, token).
Otherwise fetch two singleton values via SingletonGlobalAccessorWithFallbackAlloc(v6) and dispatch through the function pointer at v6+12 with FunctionPointerCallWithErrorHandling.
Return the allocated target struct v6.
